summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, found low risk scores of 12 for the liver and 28 for the heart [M]. Research records show sixty total trials for this drug, with three specific trial examples noted in the search [3]. One of these trials stopped because it did not meet its main goal of being effective, showing no added benefit when combining a steroid with an eye injection drug [5]. Other studies faced issues such as trouble signing up participants or disruptions from the COVID-19 pandemic [4][6].
